name: identities-v1 P-037 orchestrator typecheck (source-kind contracts, D-131 freeze)
summary: Full, non-incremental tsc --noEmit over the orchestrator package project, run from the canonical staging tree while every P-037 subject was under the D-131 freeze lock (no concurrent edits). The project's include is src/**/*.ts, so the program covers both the P-037 sources (blueprint/schema.ts, loader.ts, composition-compiler.ts, stack-mutation.ts) and their tests (blueprint/contracts.test.ts, loader.layers.test.ts, loader.test.ts). tsc printed zero diagnostics and exited 0. A census via --listFilesOnly confirmed that 207 orchestrator src files were in the program, so this is not a zero-file vacuous pass.
